claims.text: Maintenance option thought to reduce vertigo freq by increasing inner-ear blood flow; ± diuretics
claims.quote: Betahistine, another agent that may be used as maintenance therapy, is thought to reduce vertigo frequency by increasing blood flow in the inner ear; it may be used with or without diuretics

Betahistine dihydrochloride, a histamine analog that antagonizes H3 receptors and acts as a weak H1 agonist, is used worldwide for peripheral vertigo but is not approved by the Food and Drug Administration in the United States.
